coverage: Malformed/truncated MOD, PTG and PP20 refusal and every measured allocation failure preserve the full dirty 24-bit document/master.
Direct 16/24-bit MOD export refuses unchanged; explicit round8 and fixed TPDF export preserve all source storage.
Classic MOD 0/1/65535 sample-word boundaries, odd and 65536-word refusal, and loop-word encoding.
Native save producer/write/readback/existing-destination refusal checks with exact run-owned RAM paths.
limits: This records source compilation and saved objects, not native execution or OS behavior.
No native short-I/O, EINTR, ENOSPC, fsync, postcommit-cleanup or power-loss fault injection is claimed.
Valid PP20 decoding, sample-file import, editor adoption, devices, timing and listening are outside this slice.
Native stderr is not separately captured by the prepared callback. Exact stdout/RC and cleanup require later independent observation.
The earlier Mac hardening campaign remains separate; its POSIX syscall wrappers do not qualify the Amiga DOS branch.
The test requires a fresh existing empty RAM directory under the established guarded workflow; an assertion failure preserves uncertain staging.
